law: Entries are immutable once shipped: any behavior change requires a NEW template_version. Old evidence keeps its meaning because {template_id, template_version} pins the exact script that produced it (SCOPE.md section 4, G1).

templates.contract: file-exists <path> [<path>...] -- exit 0 iff every path exists and is non-empty; evidence (bytes, lines, age per path) on stdout; refusals on stderr
templates.script:
set -euo pipefail
[ $# -ge 1 ] || { echo "file-exists: needs at least one path" >&2; exit 2; }
EVIDENCE=""
for p in "$@"; do
  [ -s "$p" ] || { echo "file-exists: missing or empty: $p" >&2; exit 1; }
  bytes=$(wc -c < "$p" | tr -d ' ')
  lines=$(wc -l < "$p" | tr -d ' ')
  mt=$(stat -f %m "$p" 2>/dev/null || stat -c %Y "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  age=$(( $(date +%s) - mt ))
  EVIDENCE="${EVIDENCE:+$EVIDENCE; }present: $p (${bytes}B, ${lines} lines, ${age}s old)"
done
echo "$EVIDENCE"
exit 0

templates.contract: grep-count <pattern> <file> <min> -- exit 0 iff extended-regex pattern occurs >= min times in file; min must be >= 1 (min=0 is vacuous); dash-leading patterns never parse as options
named-test <script> [arg...] -- runs a named test script via bash; its exit code passes through unchanged; stdout/stderr pass through as evidence
